messages.text: my tracking # ···· says my package is 'out for delivery" in Burlington NJ but i live in (address hidden). Is it being delivered to wrong place?
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Looked something up in Shopify

Good news, it's going to the right place. The label on that parcel is addressed to (address hidden) (postal code ····), so nothing was misrouted. Burlington NJ is a carrier handover facility on the East Coast route, and YunExpress scans can read "out for delivery" while the parcel is still moving between facilities before the final hop to Delaware.

That one covers your Bitfortun BS-2.

Does the tracking page show a delivery date, or just the Burlington scan?
says arrived at gofo del station them next says butlington nj out for del

That reads normal. GOFO is the last-mile courier YunExpress hands off to here, and Burlington NJ is their depot for this area. The "out for delivery" scan is from the depot, not the delivery town, so the van is running your parcel down to (address hidden) from there.

If it hasn't landed by end of day tomorrow, tell me and I'll chase it with the carrier.

Anything else while I'm here?
so is it coming by fedex,ups or usps

Neither. GOFO runs their own vans for the last leg, so it won't be a FedEx, UPS or USPS truck. Usually an unmarked or small courier van, and they leave it at the door without a signature.

If the scan says delivered and you see nothing, check around the porch and with neighbours first, then come back to me and I'll open it with the carrier.
ok, still says our for del... will it be delivered today if it is in burlington nj?

Usually yes, an out-for-delivery scan means it's on a van for today, often into the evening. I can't promise it though, because if that scan was made at the depot before the run, GOFO sometimes rolls it to the next day.

Give it until tomorrow evening. If it hasn't arrived by then, message me here and I'll chase GOFO on it.
will it say delivered rt away or a delay?

The scan usually lags. GOFO drivers upload in batches, so the parcel can be sitting at your door an hour or two before tracking flips to delivered, and sometimes it doesn't update until the next morning.

So trust the door before the tracking page. If it shows delivered and there's nothing there, that's when to tell me.
i will go check now then bc i dont want it outside for long
Used the chat-interview skill

Good plan.

Before you go, one thing: are you thinking about adding a second miner alongside the BS-2?
i have 2 nerdaxe++ already and an oxtaxe Y that died i am waiting on inf to send it back RMA

Sorry, that one slipped past me. The R. form is the intake, and it gets you the return label:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

Fill it in and processing runs up to 10 days once the unit lands at the warehouse.

One thing I have to ask: was the Octaxe ever overclocked or modified? Tampered units aren't covered, and it saves you shipping it if so.

Have you already been waiting on someone for that label?
i already filled form last driday
Handed to the team · RMA label not issued since Friday; label issuing is not mine to do.

Then you've done your part, the label is on us. I've pinged the team to get it out to you.

Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in here. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.

Go check the porch, I'll be here.
I have a cam i can try to watch for the del van. i will look on it when i can bc i m on 3rd floor and a lot of steps to go down for no reason

Smart, save the stairs. GOFO vans are usually plain white, no branding, so watch for a driver on foot with a small box.

And while you're watching: what made you go for the BS-2 this time instead of another NerdQaxe?

You're right, and I won't dress it up. The listing now reads 8.5 TH/s, revised after the first units were measured, at the same $360. You bought it as a 10.

It's still a step up on your NerdQaxe++ at 6 TH/s, water cooled, about 150 W at the wall and around 45 dB, so it's a good box for a third floor.

Do you want me to put the hashrate difference in front of the team?

Sorry for the confusion.
